title: SearchSnippet/get maps a non-object filter to unsupportedFilter
description: crate-jmap-mail-server/src/snippet.rs:101-104 decodes filter with EmailFilter::deserialize(v).map_err(|_| JmapError::unsupported_filter()), so filter: 42 is unsupportedFilter. RFC 8621 §5.1 types SearchSnippet/get filter as FilterOperator|FilterCondition|null (objects); RFC 8620 §5.5 reserves unsupportedFilter for a syntactically valid filter. JMAP-98zb decision (non-object filter is invalidArguments everywhere) implies switching to jmap_server::filter_arg (non-consuming probe). Found during JMAP-98zb review fix; out of that scope.
